Thanks — HR has reviewed the attachments and policy. Summary and HR recommendations: 

1) Headcount: confirmed — this is an approved FTE in ENG headcount plan for Q2 (ticket HR-5123 exists).
2) Relocation policy: Redwood can approve either a reimbursement or a lump-sum. For relocation estimated at $11,800 GlobalMove supports both approaches. - "Relocation reimbursement up to $12,000 with receipts; reimbursement processed via payroll;"
